name: Sprained ankle
transcript:
You said you have a sprained ankle. One quick question: Do any of these apply right now?
OPTIONS (TICK ALL THAT APPLY): Trouble breathing - breathless, wheezing or noisy breathing (a cough or blocked nose alone does not count) | Bleeding or injury - including vomiting or coughing up blood, heavy periods, nosebleeds or a known bleeding disorder | Pale or bluish skin with cold hands and feet | None of these | Not sure

Thanks — quick check: Is the person conscious, breathing normally, and able to respond to call?
OPTIONS (TICK ALL THAT APPLY): Yes - conscious, breathing normally and responding | Cardiac arrest | Not breathing | Unresponsive | Not responding to call | Confused, agitated or disoriented | Altered mental state or not fully conscious | Obvious neurological deficits | Not sure
Yes - conscious, breathing normally and responding

Acknowledged — sprained ankle. Where or how was the person hurt? Tick all that apply.
OPTIONS (TICK ALL THAT APPLY): Head, face or neck | Chest, abdomen or pelvis (hips) | Arm, leg, hand or foot | A fall | A cut, wound, burn or other skin injury | None of these | Not sure

Thanks — about the arm, leg, hand or foot injury: tick all that apply.
OPTIONS (TICK ALL THAT APPLY): Badly crushed or mangled | Arm or leg cut off (above the wrist or ankle) | Finger, toe or part of the hand / foot cut off | Bleeding that will not stop | Possible broken thigh bone or upper-arm bone | Bone showing through the skin | A joint looks out of place (dislocated) | Numbness, tingling, or cannot move a finger / toe properly | Problem with a cast or splint | The injury is to the hand | None of these | Not sure

Thanks — Is there chest pain or other pain? How severe is it on a scale of 0 to 10?
OPTIONS: Severe chest pain | Severe pain (8-10) | Moderate pain (4-7) | Mild pain (1-3) | No pain (0) | Not sure

Acknowledged — you have moderate pain from a sprained ankle. Is the person having a seizure, or unable to sit, stand, walk or communicate?
OPTIONS (TICK ALL THAT APPLY): Ongoing seizures | Cannot sit or stand unsupported | Cannot stand or walk unsupported | Cannot communicate | Alert, walking and talking normally | Not sure

Level 3 - Urgent
Needs urgent medical assessment: go to an Emergency Department (target: under 30 minutes).
Key findings: sprained ankle with moderate pain (pain score 4–7).
Advice: Keep the ankle supported and avoid putting weight on it. Use ice, compression and elevation if available and tolerable. Seek urgent assessment at an ED.
This is a preliminary screening, not a medical diagnosis. It does not replace assessment by a healthcare professional. If symptoms worsen, call 999.
